focal_entities.receiver: the maintainer of rn, who changes these scripts and runs their tests, and the conductor's steps, which run them

goal_orientation.use: to give the conductor, on every run, the checklists for a kind, the content file's place, the task as a CCS and the report, the same way each time

goal_orientation.acceptance: every test passes and holds a sentence of the content; every stop says what went wrong and what to do; every line of the scripts is there for a behavior some test checks

constraints.rule: Python 3.9 with the standard library only; tools.sh is sh. Run the tests with python3 -m unittest discover -s dev/rn/tests from the folder the work is made in, and see each fail before its code is written; the tests find rn's checklists at <rn's folder>/checklists, so copy rn/checklists/ beside the scripts there to run them.
